title: [DocDB] REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY FAILED
body:
Jira Link: [DB-577](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-577)
**Description:**

version :2.11.2.0-b54

when  Refresh of Materialized view with concurrently fails with column x does not exist; without concurrently refresh succeeds.

**Issue:**

when the base table is created and data inserted it is created successfully and MV is created and index on mv created (with "no data" clause), Also MV is refreshed without concurrently clause - succeeds but when MV is refreshed with concurrently clause - fails with the following error
```
ERROR: column newdata.sellerid does not exist
LINE 1: ...wdata FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata WHERE (newdata).S...
^
QUERY: SELECT newdata FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata WHERE (newdata).SellerId IS NULL AND (newdata).followers IS NULL OR newdata IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata2 WHERE newdata2 IS NOT NULL AND newdata2 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.*=) newdata AND newdata2.ctid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<>) newdata.ctid)
```
use case:

```
CREATE TABLE xyz. user (
"RowId" uuid,
"xyzId" bigint NOT NULL,
"UserId" bigint NOT NULL,
"CreatedDate" timestamp without time zone,
"LastModifiedDate" timestamp without time zone,
"CreatedBy" character varying,
"ModifiedBy" character varying,
"IsDeleted" boolean
);

insert into xyz.user values ('abc0000000',1,1,null,null,'aa','bb',false);

select * from xyz.user;

ALTER TABLE public.selleruser OWNER TO yugabyte;
-- Name: idx_RowId; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: yugabyte

CREATE INDEX "idx_RowId" ON xyz.user USING lsm ("RowId" HASH);
-- Name: idx_xyzid_rowid_isdeleted; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: yugabyte

CREATE INDEX idx_sellerid_rowid_isdeleted ON xyz.user USING lsm ("xyzId" HASH, "IsDeleted" ASC, "RowId" ASC) WHERE ("IsDeleted" = false);
-- Name: idx_su_xyz_id; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: yugabyte

CREATE INDEX idx_su_xyz_id ON xyz.userUSING lsm ("xyzId" HASH);
-- Name: idx_su_user_id; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: yugabyte

CREATE INDEX idx_su_user_id ON xyz.user USING lsm ("UserId" HASH);
-- Name: ux_selleruser_sellerid_userid; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: yugabyte

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_selleruser_sellerid_userid ON public.selleruser USING lsm ("SellerId" ASC, "UserId" ASC) WHERE ("IsDeleted" = false);

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW xyz.user_followers_lookup AS
SELECT s."SellerId",
count(s."RowId") AS followers
FROM public.selleruser s
WHERE (s."IsDeleted" = false)
GROUP BY s."SellerId"
HAVING (count(s."RowId") > 1000)

WITH NO DATA;
-- Name: xyz_user_lookup_xyzId_idx; Type: INDEX; Schema: public; Owner: seller-store-follow_appuser

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "xyz_user_lookup_xyzId_idx" ON public.seller_followers_lookup USING btree ("xyzId");

REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW xyz_user_lookup;
select * from xyz_user_lookup;

REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY xyz_user_lookup;
Results in Error

ERROR: column newdata.xyzid does not exist
LINE 1: ...wdata FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata WHERE (newdata).S...
^
QUERY: SELECT newdata FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata WHERE (newdata).SellerId IS NULL AND (newdata).followers IS NULL OR newdata IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_temp_2.pg_temp_16729 newdata2 WHERE newdata2 IS NOT NULL AND newdata2 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.*=) newdata AND newdata2.ctid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<>) newdata.ctid)

```
Reference Ticket:#2529
